metadata.title: The Watch That Did Not Come Back

series.title: The Quiet Seals
series.episodeTitle: The Watch That Did Not Come Back

setup.pitch: Hearthford’s night watch marched into the fog. At dawn, their footprints came back without them.
setup.gmSummary: Six watchfolk followed a horn beyond Eastbarrow and vanished. Their footprints returned to the gate by themselves. Captain Elian Vale cracked an old muster-stone while trying to summon its dead defenders during a raid. The damaged oath now commands the dead company to HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED. At midnight it will march into Hearthford for six living replacements. The party can repair the oath, prove lawful relief, bargain a new oath, or destroy the seal and fight. Required facts have redundant physical and NPC sources; no named NPC is required.
setup.campaignFrame: A self-contained Quiet Seals night. Prior endings may color Brune’s dialogue but do not change the adventure graph.

quest.objective: Find the missing watch and stop the dead company before midnight.
quest.stakes: At midnight the dead company enters Hearthford and takes six living replacements.
quest.deadline: Midnight; show a four-step clock: sunset, first horn, second horn, midnight.
successConditions: The six watchfolk are freed or their fate is knowingly resolved.
The dead company cannot claim six Hearthford replacements at midnight.
failureConditions: Midnight arrives with the oath unresolved and Hearthford undefended.

facts.text: The Eastbarrow muster-stone binds a dead road-company to an old defensive oath.
Captain Elian Vale cracked the muster-stone while desperately trying to summon the old defenders during a raid.
At midnight the dead company will enter Hearthford and claim six living replacements unless its oath is resolved.

secrets.text: The dead captain obeys the exact last order carved beneath the broken stone: HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED.
secrets.revealCondition: Read the lower inscription, hear Nessa repeat the captain’s words, or question a sentry.

pathPressure.principle: Pay preparation with concrete advantages, tax rushing with position and time, but never lock the ending; the party can still finish by changing approach.
prepared: Solving the dispatch box before two failures provides mason’s wire, granting the first REPAIR success automatically.
Bringing the roster or rubbing lowers the lawful RELEASE check from DC 14 to DC 12 and suppresses Command the Line in round 1 if combat begins.
rushed: Skipping the camp removes the automatic REPAIR success from mason’s wire.
Reaching the muster without the roster/rubbing keeps RELEASE at DC 14 and gives no round-1 suppression of Command the Line.

npcs.name: Captain Brune Holt
voiceCues: Repeats the last order when worried.
wants: Learn the truth if they cannot return
npcs.questFunction: Points east; the ledger and returned footprints replace him if unavailable.

npcs.name: Watcher Nessa Reed
voiceCues: Whispers so the dead do not count her.
Calls the undead the old watch.
knows: The dead demand six until relieved
believes: The company can be reasoned with

npcs.questFunction: Human face of the rescue and redundant clue source.

npcs.name: Captain Elian Vale
voiceCues: Answers tactical questions immediately and moral questions slowly.
fears: Being remembered as the man who doomed the watch
knows: He cracked the stone during the raid

locations.name: Hearthford East Gate
locations.description: Mud, gatehouse, and six ownerless sets of returning bootprints.

locations.name: Eastbarrow Road
locations.description: A hedged military road where fog lies ankle-deep and old mileposts bear tally marks.

locations.name: Abandoned Watch Camp
locations.description: Cold cookfire, six bedrolls, and a torn duty roster pinned under a cup.

locations.name: Broken Muster Field
locations.description: A 70-by-60-foot field around a split standing stone; six living watchfolk kneel inside spectral spearpoints.

scenes.title: 1. The Footprints Came Home
scenes.purpose: Hook the party, start the midnight clock, and point east without requiring Brune.
scenes.readAloud: Six lines of muddy bootprints cross the east bridge and stop beneath Hearthford’s gate. No boots stand in them. Beyond the wall, a horn sounds once from the dark hills. Captain Brune Holt holds up the watch ledger. ‘Six went out. Their tracks came back. They did not.’
gmNotes: Objective: follow the returned tracks east before the second horn.
DC 12 Wisdom (Survival): confirm the prints match the missing watch and point toward town. Failure: a broken watch badge and gate ledger still point east.
Physical clue: the gate ledger records the patrol’s destination as Eastbarrow’s old muster-stone.
Clock: sunset now; first horn after the road; second horn entering the muster field; midnight after roughly four hours or deliberate delay.

scenes.title: 2. The Toll of the Old Road
scenes.purpose: Offer fight, sneak, or talk and show that the dead enforce an oath rather than hunt randomly.
scenes.readAloud: Fog fills the ditches like pale water. Three armored figures stand across the road beneath a rotted banner. Their shields bear no crest, only six vertical cuts. The center figure lowers a spear. ‘Name your watch. Name who relieves you.’
gmNotes: Objective: pass without spending too much time or blood.
Talk: DC 13 Charisma (Persuasion) while claiming lawful relief. Success: passage and HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED. Failure: they demand one weapon as surety; refusal starts combat.
Sneak: DC 13 group Dexterity (Stealth) through the hedge. Failure starts combat 30 feet from the sentries.
Combat reference is on this stage through enc-sentries. The sentries stop fighting when lawfully relieved.
Map: road 15 ft. wide; hedges half cover; ditch difficult terrain; sentries 30 ft. ahead.

scenes.title: 3. Six Names on the Roster
scenes.purpose: Deliver the puzzle, Vale’s guilt, physical clue backups, and preparation rewards.
scenes.readAloud: The watch camp is laid for six people who never slept here. Six bedrolls. Six tin cups. Six names on a duty roster. A seventh line has been scratched so hard the parchment tore: RELIEF — NONE.
gmNotes: Objective: open the dispatch box and learn how to approach the muster field prepared.
Puzzle prompt: Six brass tags read DAWN, NOON, DUSK, MIDNIGHT, RELIEF, RETURN. Put them in the old watch cycle shown by the roster. Solution: Dawn → Noon → Dusk → Midnight → Relief → Return.
DC 13 Intelligence (Investigation or History) spots peg wear and solves it. After two wrong attempts the box opens anyway, but the first horn sounds and the prepared advantage is lost.
Inside: Vale’s written confession, a charcoal rubbing reading HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED, and mason’s binding wire.

Trap: lifting the roster without pinning the black wax seal triggers the memory-horn; DC 13 Wisdom save, 2d6 psychic and deafened until end of next turn on failure, half damage/no deafened on success. Clues remain accessible.

scenes.title: 4. Hold Six Until Relieved
scenes.purpose: Rescue the watch through repair, release, bargain, or battle.
scenes.readAloud: The standing stone has split from crown to base. Six living watchfolk kneel around it, awake and rigid. Beyond them waits a line of dead soldiers, transparent beneath old mail. Their captain plants a broken standard in the earth. ‘Six held,’ he says. ‘Name the relief.’
gmNotes: Objective: resolve the oath before midnight; killing the captain is only one option.
REPAIR: 3 successes before 2 failures, one action each, DC 13 Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Intelligence (Arcana/Religion). Camp wire grants the first success automatically.
RELEASE: expose the lower inscription and make DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion); DC 12 with roster/rubbing. Success lets the company stand down forever.
BARGAIN: DC 14 Charisma (Persuasion) with a willing hero promising to return at next new moon to formally dismiss the company. The six go free now.
BREAK: stone AC 15, 30 HP, immune psychic/poison. Destroying it frees the six but starts enc-last-watch. Captain yields at 10 HP if offered lawful relief.
Prepared advantage: roster at the stone prevents Command the Line in round 1.
Map: 70x60 ft.; stone center; captives in 15-ft. ring; captain 20 ft. north; sentries 15 ft. east/west; low wall south gives half cover.

scenes.title: 5. The Empty Seventh Place
scenes.purpose: Pay the party and record the consequence of their chosen solution.
scenes.readAloud: At Hearthford’s gate, six watch cloaks hang from six shoulders again. Brune counts them twice before he looks at you. Far behind, Eastbarrow’s horn gives one last note — or, if you broke the stone, none at all. On the old duty ledger, a seventh line has appeared in faded ink: HEARTHFORD — RELIEVED.
gmNotes: Reward: 200 gp total; add the recovered silver watch-badge worth 50 gp if all six return alive.
Repaired: spectral defenders make the road safer. Released: the field becomes quiet. Bargained: record the new-moon promise. Broken: the road loses its supernatural defense.
Campaign revelation: this Quiet Seal was a protective bargain, not merely a prison.

clues.revelation: The muster-stone binds an old defensive company.
sources: Physical record: gate ledger names the old muster-stone and carries its seal-mark.
NPC: Vale recounts the local story of defenders called from the stone.
Physical inscription: the dispatch-box rubbing shows the binding circle and oath.

clues.revelation: Vale cracked the stone while trying to summon help during a raid.
sources: Physical note: Vale’s unsent confession is inside the dispatch box.
NPC: Vale confesses when shown the rubbing or challenged with the evidence.
Physical evidence: hammer marks in the stone match Vale’s watch hammer.

clues.revelation: The company must hold six until relieved and will take six replacements at midnight.
sources: Physical inscription: HOLD SIX UNTIL RELIEVED; MIDNIGHT MUSTER.
NPC: Nessa heard the captain announce the replacement.
Encounter: road sentries repeat the relief demand and six-count.

encounters.objective: Pass the sentries by talk, stealth, or combat.
encounters.bypass: Credible relief order or successful group Stealth.
encounters.talkOut: DC 13 Charisma (Persuasion) while claiming lawful relief; success opens the road. Showing the duty roster or a credible relief order ends combat immediately.

creatures.name: Oathbound Sentry
creatures.trait: Formation Guard (reaction, once per round per group): +2 AC to an adjacent sentry against one triggering attack.
creatures.morale: Stops if lawfully relieved; never pursues toward Hearthford.

encounters.difficulty: Moderate-to-High only if violence is chosen
encounters.objective: Free the six and resolve the oath.
encounters.bypass: Repair, release, or bargain ends the crisis without killing the dead.
encounters.talkOut: Present lawful relief, complete a successful RELEASE check, or bargain a new oath. During combat the captain also yields at 10 HP if shown the roster and offered lawful relief.

creatures.name: Captain of the Last Watch
creatures.attack: Longsword +5 to hit, 1d8+3 slashing plus 1d4 necrotic; two attacks on his turn.
creatures.action: Command the Line (Recharge 5–6): each allied sentry moves up to half speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
creatures.morale: Yields at 10 HP if offered lawful relief.

creatures.name: Oathbound Sentry
creatures.trait: Formation Guard (reaction, once per round per group): +2 AC to adjacent sentry against one triggering attack.

tactics: Captain protects the stone rather than chasing ranged attackers.
Sentries block routes to captives but do not attack a helpless captive.
If roster/rubbing is present, skip Command the Line in round 1.

rewards.name: Hearthford watch purse
rewards.how: Awarded when the six are freed or their fate is resolved and Hearthford is safe.

rewards.name: Silver watch-badge
rewards.how: Recovered if all six return alive; functions as proof of lawful Hearthford watch business in later Quiet Seals adventures.

flow: Road: talk / sneak / fight → Camp or Muster
Muster: repair / release / bargain / break → Return
checks: Road Persuasion DC 13 or group Stealth DC 13
Camp Investigation/History DC 13; trap Wisdom DC 13
Muster REPAIR DC 13; RELEASE DC 14 or 12 prepared; BARGAIN DC 14

encounters: Muster if BREAK: Captain of Last Watch + 2 Sentries; captain yields at 10 HP if lawfully relieved.
checks: REPAIR DC 13 / RELEASE DC 14 (12 prepared) / BARGAIN DC 14
rewards: 50 gp silver watch-badge if all six return
